note: Each company carries a different record, as production does. v1 passed no record at all and therefore measured the business-model prior alone, which is what exposed the within-class collapse.

rows.question: For Cloudflare, Inc.: what to charge, and for what, without losing more customer count than the price gains?
signals: sales and marketing to acquire an account
infrastructure and delivery cost per unit served
rows.causal: Did the pricing or packaging change alter conversion and expansion, or did it only move realised price on the customers who renewed anyway?

rows.question: For Shopify Inc.: how the product is sold, and by whom, measured on acquisition cost per unit of customer count?
signals: sales and marketing to acquire an account
infrastructure and delivery cost per unit served
rows.causal: Did the change in sales motion improve acquisition efficiency relative to comparable vendors over the same window?

rows.question: For Johnson & Johnson: how to respond to what the regulator has done, before the decision changes what may be sold, or at what price?
rows.causal: Did the regulatory decision change the addressable population, or only the label under which it is reached?

rows.question: For Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.: how much capacity to commit, and when, given that manufacturing and foundry cost is committed before the unit volume it is meant to serve arrives?
rows.causal: Did the capacity commitment convert into shipped volume, or into inventory that the channel had already stocked?

rows.question: For The Boeing Company: how much capacity to commit, and when, given that supply chain and component availability is committed before the orders and backlog it is meant to serve arrives?
signals: aftermarket and services on the installed base
rows.causal: Did the production rate increase convert backlog into deliveries, or did it accumulate work in progress the supply chain cannot finish?

rows.question: For Bank of America Corporation: what to charge, and for what, without losing more spread on assets and liabilities than the price gains?
rows.causal: Did the repricing widen the spread, or did the cost of funds follow it up within the same window?

rows.question: For Agnico Eagle Mines Limited: where the next increment of capital goes, given what the same capital would earn against produced volume elsewhere?
rows.causal: Did the capital committed to this project earn a return distinguishable from what the commodity price alone delivered?
